# Cohort flow (generated by `python -m polysafe.labels`)

Events = AKI with onset in (T, min(T + 7 d, ICU discharge)], by creatinine or acute RRT, among the stays remaining after each step.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Start |  | 2,520 | 1,841 | 232 | 9.2% | all ICU unit stays in patient.csv.gz |
| Stay < 24 h | 893 | 1,627 | 1,333 | 232 | 14.3% | ICU discharge or death before T, so no prediction time exists |
| Chronic dialysis / ESRD | 62 | 1,565 | 1,292 | 198 | 12.7% | AKI is not definable on chronic dialysis |
| AKI by T (baseline A) | 168 | 1,397 | 1,161 | 110 | 7.9% | met KDIGO stage >= 1 on creatinine drawn <= T; nothing left to predict |
| Acute RRT by T | 3 | 1,394 | 1,158 | 109 | 7.8% | dialysis / CVVH started <= T: prevalent KDIGO stage 3 |
| No baseline A | 146 | 1,248 | 1,054 | 107 | 8.6% | no serum creatinine in the first 24 h |
| No observable outcome | 380 | 868 | 756 | 107 | 12.3% | no serum creatinine and no RRT start in (T, min(T + 7 d, ICU discharge)] |
| **Primary estimand: medication-recording sites** | 197 | **671** | 586 | 78 | 11.6% | site-level restriction (section 6); not a predictor |
